claude_proposed_widenings.name: targetTypeFilter on modify_roll_numeric / modify_damage_numeric
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The +1/+3 bifurcation on attack and damage rolls is gated on whether the target is a Construct. Neither modify_roll_numeric nor modify_damage_numeric currently carry a targetTypeFilter, so the conditional bonus is inexpressible.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The bonus increases to +3 when you use the weapon to attack a Construct.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: weapon_crit trigger variant in MasteryTrigger (or a new OnHitTriggerMechanics trigger kind)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The extra-damage rider fires specifically on a natural 20, not on every hit. The existing trigger union only covers weapon_hit and weapon_hit_melee_only; there is no on_crit / natural_20 trigger.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you roll a 20 on an attack roll made with this weapon, the target takes an extra 7 Bludgeoning damage...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: targetTypeFilter on damage EffectAtom (or a conditional DiceAmount variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The extra-crit damage is 7 normally but 14 vs Constructs. Neither DiceAmount nor the damage EffectAtom support branching the amount on the target's creature type.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...the target takes an extra 7 Bludgeoning damage, or 14 Bludgeoning damage if it's a Construct.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: destroy_creature (or instant_kill with hp_threshold gate)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: If a Construct has 25 HP or fewer after the crit damage, it is destroyed outright. This is not damage to 0 HP — it is an instantaneous destruction keyed on a post-damage HP threshold for a specific creature type. No existing EffectAtom covers this; the closest (apply_condition: unconscious) is wrong because Constructs don't have the dying/unconscious mechanic.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If a Construct has 25 Hit Points or fewer after taking this damage, it is destroyed.
